turns.text: Hello, come in. How have you been since last time?
Some days are better than others, and I try to remind myself of that when things get heavy.
Tell me more about that.
I left Oliver with Tom for an hour on Saturday and went to the shop alone.
What went through your mind then?
The train was late again this morning, so I almost did not make it on time today. I think so, yes.
What happened next?
I made myself a cup of tea this morning and just stood by the window for a while.
And how was that for you?
We booked a trip to Aberdeen at Easter so Mum can meet Oliver properly.
And how was that for you?
I wrote a few notes before coming here, but now I cannot remember half of what I wanted to say. That is how it was.
Tell me more about that.
The anxiety is much lower, I would say four out of ten instead of nine.
Take your time.
It has been a grey week, and the weather does not help my mood much, to be honest. That is how it was.
What happened next?
I am not sure where to begin, there are so many things going round in my head at the moment.
Mm-hm. Go on.
I am less afraid about going back to work now that I have until January.
I see. Can you say a bit more?
It is strange to sit here and say all of this out loud, but it does help a little. I do not know, it is hard to explain.
What went through your mind then?
The journey here took a while, but at least I had time to gather my thoughts.
We are nearly out of time. Is there anything you want to add?
No, I think that is everything. Thank you.
